item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence on `nonproliferation`, `nuclear-weapon-free zone`, `safeguards`, `proxy weapons`, `Hamas smuggling`, and `Egypt Sisi proliferation`. I did not find a clean 2024 case where Sisi had to overrule an ally, proxy, client, or domestic faction that wanted proliferation for political advantage. I also did not find reliable evidence that Sisi encouraged proliferation in 2024. The closest contrary signal was Israel’s allegation of weapons smuggling from Egyptian territory in late 2024, but that was disputed and denied by Egyptian officials, so it is not strong affirmative evidence of permissive proliferation.
